messages.subject: Whitcombe - merits and settlement advice (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley, Diane,

Please find attached our advice on the merits and on settlement. It is legally privileged - please keep it within the group copied.

In summary: we think we have a decent case on ordinary unfair dismissal, but the whistleblowing limb carries real and uncapped risk, and we'd assess our chances of defeating it at around 60-65%. On a risk-adjusted basis the realistic exposure is well into six figures. We recommend opening settlement discussions through ACAS, with an initial offer around £85,000 and authority to go up to about £115,000 plus a costs contribution and an agreed reference.

Grateful for your authority to proceed on that basis - happy to talk it through.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment & Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
